gloss: upstream; upper reaches of a river

definitions.gloss: upstream; upper reaches of a river
definitions.explanation: The part of a river closer to its source, or the direction from which the water flows.

definitions.gloss: upstream (in a supply chain or process)
definitions.explanation: The earlier stages of a production or supply chain, closer to raw materials or initial creation.

examples.japanese: {川上|かわかみ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{流|なが}れて→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧きた。
{川上|かわかみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かって→向かう：01186_mukau⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: I walked toward the upper reaches of the river.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{川上|かわかみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ダム→ダム：00034_damu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{放流|ほうりゅう}→放流：18495_houryuu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The dam upstream released water due to heavy rain.

examples.japanese: {川上|かわかみ}⟦{産業|さんぎょう}→産業：01419_sangyou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{川下|かわしも}⟦{産業|さんぎょう}→産業：01419_sangyou⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{一貫|いっかん}して⟦{管理|かんり}する→管理する：21910_kanrisuru⟧。
examples.english: To manage consistently from upstream industries to downstream industries.

examples.japanese: ⟦{製造|せいぞう}→製造：03289_seizou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{川上|かわかみ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{管理|かんり}する→管理する：21910_kanrisuru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: It is important to control quality at the upstream stage of manufacturing.

examples.english: A system is needed for information to flow accurately from upstream to downstream.

notes:
The literal meaning refers to the upper part of a river, near its source. In business, {川上|かわかみ} and {川下|かわしも} are commonly used as a metaphor for stages in a supply chain or value chain.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {川上|かわかみ}⟦{産業|さんぎょう}→産業：01419_sangyou⟧: upstream industry (raw materials, manufacturing)
- {川上|かわかみ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{川下|かわしも}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: from upstream to downstream
- {川上|かわかみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遡|さかのぼ}る→遡る：04003_sakanoboru⟧: to go upstream; to trace back to the source

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {川下|かわしも}: downstream — the lower part of a river, or the later stages of a supply chain (distribution, retail)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{上流|じょうりゅう}→上流：15028_jouryuu⟧: upper stream — can be used similarly for rivers and also figuratively for upper class
- ⟦{源流|げんりゅう}→源流：13359_genryuu⟧: headwaters, source — the very origin of a river or tradition
